title: STIPS: the Small Telescope Image Processing Suite
description:
STIPS brings the Rubin Observatory LSST Science Pipelines to 1-meter class telescopes. It wraps the LSST reduction stack with a declarative instrument profile, prefab pipelines, and a unified command-line interface for calibration, difference imaging, forced photometry, and lightcurve extraction. Supported instruments are the Nickel 1-m at Lick Observatory and the CTIO 1.0-m with Y4KCam.

If you use STIPS, please also cite the LSST Science Pipelines it is built on.
